limitations: Safety reflects recorded crime, not all crime, and is not a prediction or personal-safety guarantee.
Eleven areas in Epping Forest fall outside Greater London; their recent crime coverage is incomplete and must not be treated as zero crime.
Education combines Census qualifications and historic Ofsted inspection outcomes. It is not a school admissions or current school-quality assessment.
Transport includes Elizabeth line, Overground, River Bus, Circle, District, Metropolitan and Hammersmith & City only. It does not measure commute times or the full TfL network.
Grocery covers full-size Waitrose and M&S Food stores only; it does not measure general food access.
Quiet uses road noise only, excluding aircraft, rail and nightlife noise.
Rent, property availability, park access, air quality and individual needs are not included in these scores.
Best-fit ward names locate Output Areas administratively; scores apply to the selected Output Area, not the entire ward.
